result.boot_instruction: Read get_universal_contract before analysis. Existing business_logic_sweep supports UMTB4 JSON in context, including method_lookup, presentation and explicit atomic_review, when client discovery has not yet exposed dedicated tools.

method_inventory.counting_rule: Overlapping framework families, mirrors, transformations and executable evaluators are separate inventories. Do not sum them as executed methods.
rule: Do not run every method blindly.
Run the methods capable of changing the active classifier state.

result.serialization: Sorted object keys using JavaScript UTF-16 order; JSON.stringify primitive encoding; array order preserved; schema admits only integer numbers. Versioned custom format, not a JCS conformance claim.
result.adoption: Blocked: requires a separate trusted proof and approval gate.
result.adapters: Adapters supply declared sources; this module does not retrieve or authenticate them.
result.compatibility: Separate universal contract; does not replace the Python proof-gate packet or registry.
result.authorization: Pure read-only function; no dispatch, persistence, external action, or automatic promotion.

boot_sequence: Normalize supplied records into declared typed structures and analytical questions. Never invent missing sources or method inputs.
Call route_problem; existing business_logic_sweep also accepts routing, or context set to UMTB4: followed by JSON of this input_schema.
Read get_method_ark or get_method_catalog for bounded model requirements. No evaluator runs automatically.

For controlled atomic variations call review_atomic_variants, or supply atomic_review in this input. PLAN is the default; EXECUTE_SUPPLIED_MODELS must be explicit. Read get_universal_contract.atomic_review first.

Use render_output after analysis, preserving every claim state. If unavailable, supply presentation in the routing input through existing sweep context. Use method_lookup for Method Ark discovery through the same path.
universal_router.missing_evidence_policy: No typed frame means BLOCKED and zero activations. Country comparisons do not by themselves activate money, replay or settlement.
universal_router.evidence_boundary: References are caller declarations, not source authentication or authorization. REQUIRED/ACTIVE means structurally selected, not a finding.
universal_router.child_gate_boundary: Only the question-specific default lenses activate; additional unsupported lenses remain BLOCKED. Registry coverage is not applicability.

atomic_review.atom_unit: One declared variable/value, with identity, source, classifiers, parent, dependencies, falsifier and expected record.
atomic_review.identity_policy: Caller-supplied native atom IDs and typed subject identities are preserved. Test variants do not mint canonical classifiers.
atomic_review.operator_execution_scope: Finite supplied atom states; model projections are explicitly bound by JSON pointers. Transform labels do not imply formal solver completeness.
atomic_review.method_packet_key_value_normalization: The original declaration LEGAL EFFECT CLAIMED? = NO is represented by key LEGAL EFFECT CLAIMED? with value NO.

reduction_identity.identity_vs_sha256: Native heading calls this a reduction hash, but the declared MMR string is an identity format; it is not a SHA256 digest algorithm.
reduction_identity.runtime_receipt_rule: Original object/child/MMR identities and declared source-version namespaces remain distinct from computed source, base-state, model, run, or artifact SHA256 digests. A digest never establishes source authenticity or occurrence of an event.

atomic_review.method_discovery: get_method_ark catalog_layer selects IMPLEMENTED, METHOD_HOOKS, FRAMEWORK_OPERATORS, REDUCTION_METHODS, TRANSFORMATIONS or MIRRORS. Limit 1–5; follow next_offset.
atomic_review.no_material_gain_stop: No fixed maximum depth; stop if the split cannot change any material coordinate, proof gap, or record-acquisition strategy.
atomic_review.invariants: A newly violated supplied invariant creates a MODEL_COUNTEREXAMPLE_CANDIDATE; native proof and impact remain separate.

method_inventory.counting_rule: Overlapping framework families, mirrors, transformations and executable evaluators are separate inventories. Do not sum them as executed methods.
rule: Do not run every method blindly.
Run the methods capable of changing the active classifier state.

correspondence.rule: Do not substitute possession, permission, ownership, or capacity for one another.

correspondence.legal: exact subject / procedural state / native record
correspondence.rule: Bind each state claim to the same subject, source version and quoted span.
Distinguish the stated rule from evidence that it was applied.
Separate displayed amounts, pending events and final authoritative outcomes.

review_lenses.question: What did each actor know at the recorded time, and which source establishes it?
Which recorded stage makes the outcome final, and which later stages remain unresolved?
Do quantities reconcile using consistent units and the same object and time window?
Is controller or accumulator state evidenced, inferred, or unknown?
Could an earlier queued event explain the observed result? Preserve competing explanations.
Where do two supplied records first differ after identity and version are aligned?
Which native authority owns the state being asserted?
What supplied evidence would defeat the proposition?

review_bridge.execution: Review questions only; no game-theory solver, legal conclusion, exploit generation, or external testing.
review_bridge.evidence: Use get_universal_contract, then validate_evidence_packet to check exact versions, subject references, spans and dependencies. Structural PASS does not establish truth or legal applicability.

normal_answer_contract.purpose: Readable review of supplied evidence, backed by exact registry links
rules: Do not dump the registry into normal answers. Show only referenced IDs and material distinctions.
Preserve printed identity, operative function, actor/capacity, authority, time/version and finality separately.
A shared MAXVAR parent is a cross-reference, not equivalence or proof.
Method agreement is not independent corroboration.
Report the evidence state on each axis; a binary pass/fail is not a substitute.
No automated target actions or vulnerability reproduction are executed by these lookup tools.

resolver_actions.CREATE: Explicit initial alias allocation; save private resolver and checksum.
resolver_actions.REUSE: Exact checkpoint membership with saved resolver and expected checksum.
resolver_actions.ADVANCE: New checkpoint; preserve existing project/record handles and typed identity, add only new handles.

research_storage.identity_rule: Native namespace and ID type are exact; numeric MAXVAR is distinct from string registry IDs. Ordinal is separate. TYPED_V2 uses empty legacy classifier_ids/method_ids and registered typed references.

propositional_entailment.retrieval: Author-provided chapter opened with parsed text.
propositional_entailment.supports: Finite truth-assignment enumeration checks whether every model satisfying a propositional knowledge base also satisfies a query.

finite_invariant.title: Specifying Systems
finite_invariant.retrieval: Author-provided PDF opened with parsed text.
finite_invariant.locator: Invariant/inductive invariant discussion and specification/refinement chapters; search for inductive invariant.
finite_invariant.supports: Initial-state and transition-preservation obligations justify invariance relative to a specification. A refinement relation needs explicit proof obligations, not similar labels or traces.

abductive_cover.title: Diagnostic Expert Systems Based on a Set Covering Model
abductive_cover.author_or_owner: James Reggia, Dana Nau and Pearl Wang; original author-hosted paper
abductive_cover.retrieval: Original PDF opened, but parsed text length was zero. Primary search excerpt verified a set-cover hypothesize-and-test mechanism. Tavily basic extraction failed. Fine-grained implementation equivalence was not verified.
abductive_cover.locator: Paper title/primary indexed abstract; detailed local set-cover semantics below are an explicit adaptation.
abductive_cover.supports: Diagnostic hypotheses can be organized through a set-cover model. This source does not certify the proposed bounded cover implementation.

abductive_cover.title: Abductive Logic Programming
abductive_cover.author_or_owner: Kakas, Kowalski and Toni; original authors, Imperial College archive
abductive_cover.retrieval: Original PDF opened; parsed text has substantial character-encoding artifacts. Broad framework confirmed by primary indexed description; no claim of reproducing its proof procedure.
abductive_cover.locator: Abduction, background theory, abducibles and integrity constraints.
abductive_cover.supports: Abduction forms constrained explanatory hypotheses. Covering a supplied observation set is a narrower operation than general abductive logic programming.

minimal_cut_sets.title: Model-Based Safety Analysis
minimal_cut_sets.retrieval: Official NASA-hosted PDF opened with parsed text.
minimal_cut_sets.locator: PDF page 45 discussion of extracting minimal sets of basic events producing a top-level event.
minimal_cut_sets.supports: Minimal cut sets identify minimally sufficient basic-event combinations in a model. The proposed AND/OR evaluator is a finite qualitative subset, not the publication's complete analysis system.
